data.methodology: Primary Currency Strength uses ECB-only reference rates via Frankfurter. Multi-provider data is confirmation only. Multi-Timeframe Alignment compares Daily/Weekly/Monthly ECB rankings, while Strength Percentile compares the current ECB score with prior same-timeframe ECB observations.

strength_percentile.methodology: Current ECB strength is ranked against prior same-timeframe ECB observations; directional percentile uses signed score, magnitude percentile uses absolute score.

multi_timeframe_alignment.methodology: 55% pairwise rank alignment + 25% currency direction consensus + 10% strongest consensus + 10% weakest consensus across Daily, Weekly and Monthly ECB strength.

confirmation_layer.date_alignment: Confirmation snapshots use the exact ECB period start/end dates.
confirmation_layer.scoring_method: 40% ranking + 20% score direction + 15% strongest + 15% weakest + 5% primary pair + 5% pair bias.

currency_strength_regime.evidence_source: Backtest Stage 2 walk-forward out-of-sample regime analysis
currency_strength_regime.methodology: Fixed guardrail: reject Provider Agreement <60, MTF Alignment <60, Strength Percentile <20, or Strength Percentile >=95. CONFIRMED_TREND additionally requires Composite >=80, Provider >=80, and MTF >=80. The guardrail filters continuation confidence; it does not reverse the canonical ECB signal.

state_meaning.ACTIONABLE: Evidence and operational guardrails are strong enough for further setup evaluation.
state_meaning.SELECTIVE: The signal can be reviewed selectively, but one or more layers limit readiness.
state_meaning.FILTERED: The signal is deprioritized by evidence quality or a guardrail.

decision_meaning.EVALUATE_SETUP: Continue to downstream setup/risk agents; this is not an execution instruction.
decision_meaning.REVIEW_SELECTIVELY: Keep under review with reduced priority until limiting evidence improves.
decision_meaning.DEPRIORITIZE: Do not prioritize continuation analysis while a limiting guardrail remains active.

actionability_score.note: Actionability is the primary operational layer. Composite remains underneath as evidence quality. Actionability does not estimate win rate or profitability and does not itself issue an execution instruction.
actionability_score.refinement_note: Actionability v1.1 retrospective diagnostic is complete. Pair-specific D/W/M alignment improved ACTIONABLE selection slightly versus v1.0, while Data Readiness remains primarily an operational safety layer. Fresh future out-of-sample validation is still pending.

daily.methodology: Actionability Score is the minimum of four interpretable ceilings: evidence quality, regime guardrail, pair readiness, and data readiness. Pair readiness now requires pair-specific Daily/Weekly/Monthly directional alignment; data readiness also checks evidence completeness, historical percentile sample adequacy, and business-day freshness. The score does not reverse the canonical ECB bias and is not a probability of profit.
daily.reason: Evidence quality and all operational guardrails support evaluation of the signal.
